title: Signed node-to-graph transfer by neighbor-state projection

target_design.cutoff_rule: For target index i, compute the current field and edge graph from draws[:i] only. The current transition is from the previously observed prefix to draws[:i]; freeze all 40-number rankings before reading draw i.

hypothesis: A signed projection of each number's recent pair-graph row change onto the six-dimensional prior feature states of its neighbors may describe directional transfer between relational and per-number state. A rolling, prior-only average of this signed alignment may contain information not captured by Q86 directional cosine or Q87 lagged magnitude correlation.

projection.node_delta: X_t - X_(t-1), shape 40x6, where each column is a standardized per-number field feature.
projection.graph_delta: E_t - E_(t-1), shape 40x40, symmetric with zero diagonal.
projection.neighbor_state: X_(t-1), shape 40x6, strictly prior to the current transition.
projection.signed_transfer: c_i(t) = dot(node_delta_i, G_t_i) / (norm(node_delta_i)*norm(G_t_i)); zero if either norm is zero.
projection.smoothing: Weighted mean over at most the latest 20 observed transition alignments, with fixed decay 0.80 per step; latest transition weight 1.0. No fitted parameters.

model_family: All 12 frozen Q87 models plus 3 fixed Q88 transfer operators; 15 models total.
selection: Select one of the three Q88 candidates by Discovery mean Top20 hits only; tie-break lower mean actual rank, then stable strategy ID. Do not use Validation or historical Blind OOS to select or tune.

statistics.exact_null: Discrete upper-tail convolution of iid Hypergeometric(40,k,5) hit counts, one global Holm family.
statistics.paired: Moving-block bootstrap, block length 20, 2,000 replications, one global Holm family.
statistics.paired_comparators: All 12 frozen Q87 models, on Validation and historical Blind OOS; endpoints Top5, Top10, Top20, and mean actual rank.
statistics.primary_gate: Selected historical Blind OOS Top20 lift >=0.10 versus Equal42, paired 95% CI lower bound >0, paired Holm p<0.05 and exact-null global Holm p<0.05. This historical gate is exploratory only and cannot authorize promotion.

safeguards: All node and graph states are computed from the target's strict prior prefix.
The graph change is projected using the previous prefix's neighbor feature matrix, not the current or future feature matrix.
Rolling transfer uses only transitions observed by the target cutoff; future-invariance tests are mandatory.
All operator weights, smoothing window and decay are fixed before execution.
No Validation or historical Blind OOS tuning; historical Blind OOS has prior exposure and is not a virgin holdout.
The pair graph is a statistical co-occurrence descriptor, not physical coupling or proof of causal influence.
The validator independently replays every target cutoff, transfer vector, rank permutation, metric and multiple-testing family.
No immutable freeze modification, prospective shadow insertion, engine promotion, or automatic merge.
